chunks: Every one of them will come before Him all alone on the Day of Resurrection.
ai.seo_question: How will individuals appear before God on the Day of Resurrection according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Maryam underscores the concept of *al-fard* (singularity), highlighting that on the Day of Judgment, all worldly ties and intercessors will be severed, leaving the individual solely accountable for their faith and deeds. This aligns with the theological emphasis on personal responsibility (*taklif*) while acknowledging that righteous deeds may serve as a form of spiritual companionship for the believer.
